risk_s1_title: You could lose all the money you invest
risk_s1_p1: The performance of most cryptoassets can be highly volatile, with their value dropping as quickly as it can rise. You should be prepared to lose all the money you invest in cryptoassets.
risk_s1_p2: The cryptoasset market is largely unregulated. There is a risk of losing money or any cryptoassets you purchase due to risks such as cyber-attacks, financial crime and firm failure.
risk_s2_title: You should not expect to be protected if something goes wrong
risk_s2_p1: The Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) doesn't protect this type of investment because it's not a 'specified investment' under the UK regulatory regime – in other words, this type of investment isn't recognised as the sort of investment that the FSCS can protect. Learn more by using the FSCS investment protection checker here.
risk_s2_p2: The Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) will not be able to consider complaints related to this firm. Learn more about FOS protection here.
risk_s3_title: You may not be able to sell your investment when you want to
risk_s3_p1: There is no guarantee that investments in cryptoassets can be easily sold at any given time. The ability to sell a cryptoasset depends on various factors, including the supply and demand in the market at that time.
risk_s3_p2: Operational failings such as technology outages, cyber-attacks and comingling of funds could cause unwanted delay and you may be unable to sell your cryptoassets at the time you want.
risk_s4_p1: Investments in cryptoassets can be complex, making it difficult to understand the risks associated with the investment.
risk_s4_p2: You should do your own research before investing. If something sounds too good to be true, it probably is.
risk_s5_title: Don't put all your eggs in one basket
risk_s5_p1: Putting all your money into a single type of investment is risky. Spreading your money across different investments makes you less dependent on anyone to do well.
risk_s5_p2: A good rule of thumb is not to invest more than 10% of your money in high-risk investments.
risk_a1_r1: May not always maintain a 1:1 peg to their underlying asset, leading to value fluctuations.
risk_a1_r2: Their value depends on issuer reserves, regulatory status, and market conditions, amongst other factors.
risk_a2_r1: Prices are highly volatile and often tied to experimental or unproven protocols.
risk_a2_r2: Smart contract vulnerabilities may lead to loss of funds.
risk_a3_r1: Highly speculative and prone to extreme price swings due to hype and social media trends.
risk_a3_r2: Memecoins lack intrinsic utility, making their long-term value uncertain.
risk_a4_r1: Lock-up periods may prevent access to funds for a set duration.
risk_a4_r2: Slashing penalties could result in the loss of staked funds due to network rules.
risk_a5_name: Loss of keys to non-custodial wallet
risk_a5_r1: Losing private keys or recovery phrases means losing access to funds permanently.
risk_a5_r2: No third party, including the wallet provider, can recover or restore lost wallets.
page_about_title: Building the financial layer for the open internet.
page_about_sub: fortuni is a global crypto platform where anyone, anywhere can trade, and move value across borders — as easily as sending a message.
page_about_story_p1: We started fortuni because moving money globally shouldn't take three days, five intermediaries, and a pile of paperwork. Neither should issuing a token, running a treasury, or paying a team spread across ten time zones.
page_about_story_p2: We combine the regulatory rigor of a bank with the openness of crypto rails — regulated custody, on-chain proof-of-reserves, verified P2P, and a social wallet anyone can pick up in minutes.
page_about_v1_d: Published reserves, open fee schedules, and a fully auditable on-chain treasury.
page_about_v2_d: 14+ fiat and crypto currencies, 9+ chains, dozens of languages, one unified account.
page_about_v3_d: Multi-sig custody, hardware-key support, mandatory 2FA and 98% cold-storage.
page_about_v4_d: Your keys, your coins. Non-custodial mode available for every balance.
page_about_cta_sub: Join 120,000+ people already using fortuni to trade, send, and grow their wealth.
page_about_mission_sub: Instant, borderless, and open to everyone — not just those with the right passport or the right bank.
page_about_problem_body: Sending $500 from Libya to Egypt still takes 3–5 days and eats 8–12% in fees. Millions of people across MENA have no access to basic financial infrastructure — no card, no IBAN, no way to pay online. We built fortuni to fix that.
page_about_solution_body: We combine regulated crypto rails, on-chain proof-of-reserves, and a peer-to-peer marketplace that lets any two people trade directly — safely, instantly, and at a fraction of traditional costs.
page_about_milestone1_d: Born out of frustration with SWIFT wires and broken remittance corridors across North Africa.
page_about_milestone2_d: Launched the MENA-first P2P escrow marketplace, processing thousands of trades in the first month.
page_about_milestone3_d: Issued the first fortuni virtual Visa cards — letting users spend their crypto balance anywhere Visa is accepted.
page_about_milestone4_d: Expanded to 9 chains — Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Tron, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Base and Bitcoin.
page_about_milestone5_d: Crossed 120,000 verified users across 120+ countries with $180M in monthly trading volume.
page_about_press_1_d: Every fiat balance is held in segregated accounts. Crypto reserves are published on-chain in real time. No fractional reserve, no hidden leverage.
page_about_press_2_d: 0.5% P2P, 0% bank deposits. No spread mark-up, no conversion padding. What you see is what you pay.
page_about_press_3_d: Two-week release cycles, security-first development, and a bug-bounty programme that's been running since day one.

faq_section_sub: Everything you need to know before you start. Can't find an answer?
faq_s_a1: fortuni is a MENA-first financial super-app. You can buy and sell crypto, hold fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SAR, EGP, LYD), send money internationally, trade peer-to-peer, and get a virtual Visa card — all in one place.
faq_s_a2: We focus on the MENA region: Libya, Egypt, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, Morocco, Tunisia, Algeria, Lebanon, and Iraq — plus the UK and US for the diaspora. More territories are added regularly.
faq_s_a3: You can deposit via bank transfer in your local currency, or by card (Visa / Mastercard / Apple Pay / Google Pay). On-chain crypto deposits (BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX) are also supported directly to your wallet address.
faq_s_a4: Crypto-to-crypto swaps charge 0.5%. Card deposits have a 2.9% + $0.30 processing fee. Bank transfers are free. Early-access members get 0% fees for their first 6 months.
faq_s_a5: Yes. Fiat funds are held in segregated accounts. Crypto assets are held in cold-storage wallets with multi-signature authorization. We use Sumsub for KYC/AML compliance and require identity verification before withdrawals.
faq_s_a6: The P2P marketplace lets you trade directly with other users at the rate you set. An escrow system holds funds until both parties confirm, so every trade is safe — even between strangers.
faq_s_q7: How does the virtual Visa card work?
faq_s_a7: Once KYC is approved you can issue a virtual Visa card from your fortuni balance in under 60 seconds. Use it for online purchases, subscriptions, and international payments anywhere Visa is accepted.
faq_s_q8: Do I need to complete KYC?
faq_s_a8: Basic account features (crypto deposits, viewing prices) work without KYC. Fiat deposits, withdrawals, P2P trading, and the virtual card all require identity verification — typically completed in under 5 minutes with a government ID and selfie.
faq_s_a9: Fiat: USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SAR, EGP, LYD. Crypto: BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, XRP, BNB, ADA, DOGE, MATIC, DOT, AVAX, and more being added each quarter.
faq_s_q10: How do I join the early-access waitlist?
faq_s_a10: Scroll down and enter your email. You'll get 0% fees for 6 months once we open your region. Refer friends to move up the list — each referral bumps you up automatically.

Backed by proof.
trust_sub: Every trade, every transfer, every wallet — secured by enterprise-grade infrastructure and regulatory compliance.
trust_guarantees_sub: Six layers of protection working together to keep your funds and data safe.
trust_g1_d: Transactions settle in seconds using our real-time settlement engine — no overnight holds or delayed confirmations.
trust_g2_d: All data at rest and in transit is encrypted with AES-256 and TLS 1.3. Your keys, your data — never exposed.
trust_g3_d: 95%+ of crypto assets are held in air-gapped cold wallets with multi-signature authorization and geographic redundancy.
trust_g4_d: Licensed and registered in applicable jurisdictions. We operate under applicable AML/CFT frameworks and file required regulatory reports.
trust_g5_d: Real-time proof of reserves, audit logs, and third-party security audits — published and accessible to all users.
trust_g6_d: Clear terms of service, privacy policy, and compliance documentation — written in plain language so you know exactly what you agree to.
trust_aml_sub: We take financial crime seriously. Our programme exceeds minimum regulatory requirements across every market we serve.
trust_aml1_d: Every user is verified through Sumsub's AI-powered KYC engine — government ID + liveness check completed in under 5 minutes.
trust_aml2_d: All transactions are screened in real time against OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists plus proprietary fraud models.
trust_aml3_d: We maintain full transaction records for the periods required by applicable law and provide them to authorities on request.
trust_aml4_d: Users and counterparties are re-screened continuously — not just at onboarding — using live sanctions and PEP databases.
trust_aml5_d: Withdrawal and trading limits are set dynamically based on verification tier and transaction risk score.
trust_aml6_d: Automated and human reviewers flag and report suspicious activity to the relevant financial intelligence units (FIUs) as required.
trust_legal1: Crypto assets are highly volatile. The value of your portfolio can fall to zero. Never invest more than you can afford to lose.
trust_legal2: fortuni is not a bank. Fiat balances held on the platform are not protected by government deposit insurance schemes (e.g. FDIC, FSCS).
trust_legal3: Past performance of any crypto asset is not indicative of future results. No content on this platform constitutes financial advice.
trust_legal4: P2P trades are between users. fortuni provides escrow infrastructure but is not a party to individual trades and does not guarantee counterparty performance beyond escrow release.
trust_legal5: Services may be restricted or unavailable in certain jurisdictions due to local regulations. It is your responsibility to ensure compliance with the laws of your country.
trust_legal6: The virtual Visa card is issued by a licensed e-money institution. Cardholder terms from the card issuer apply in addition to our own terms.
trust_legal7: fortuni reserves the right to freeze or close accounts found to be in violation of our terms of service, AML policy, or applicable law, with or without prior notice.
trust_cta_sub: Join thousands of users who trust fortuni to move and grow their wealth.
page_compliance_intro: fortuni is committed to operating within the legal and regulatory frameworks of every jurisdiction in which it provides services. This page describes our compliance programme, obligations, and the rights and responsibilities of our users.
page_compliance_s1_d: fortuni operates as a virtual asset service provider (VASP) and electronic money intermediary. We are registered or licensed in applicable jurisdictions and maintain ongoing dialogue with relevant regulatory authorities. Where full licensing is pending, we operate under applicable transitional or exemption frameworks.
page_compliance_s2_d: We are required by law to verify the identity of all users before enabling fiat deposits, withdrawals, P2P trading, and card issuance. Verification is powered by Sumsub and requires a government-issued photo ID and a liveness selfie. Business accounts require additional corporate documentation. Identity data is stored securely and processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
page_compliance_s3_d: Our AML programme is designed to prevent the platform from being used for money laundering, terrorist financing, or other financial crimes. It includes customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD) for high-risk accounts, real-time sanctions screening against OFAC, EU, and UN lists, ongoing transaction monitoring, and mandatory suspicious activity reporting (SAR/STR) to relevant Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs).
page_compliance_s4_d: fortuni does not provide services to individuals, entities, or countries subject to applicable sanctions programmes. All users and transactions are screened against current OFAC, EU, UN, and relevant national sanctions lists at onboarding and on an ongoing basis. Accounts identified as matching a sanctions designation will be suspended and reported to appropriate authorities.
page_compliance_s5_d: We screen all users and transactions against terrorism and terrorist financing watchlists maintained by FATF member countries. Our automated monitoring systems flag unusual transaction patterns consistent with terrorist financing typologies for human review. Any confirmed CTF risks are escalated to the relevant authorities.
page_compliance_s6_d: We process personal data in accordance with the GDPR (where applicable), and equivalent local data protection laws in the jurisdictions we serve. You have the right to access, correct, and request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention obligations. Please see our Privacy Policy for full details.
page_compliance_s7_d: We retain transaction records, KYC documentation, and account activity logs for the minimum periods required by applicable law — typically 5 to 7 years depending on jurisdiction. These records are available to authorised regulatory bodies and law enforcement upon lawful request. Internal compliance audits are conducted annually by our compliance team.
page_compliance_s8_d: If you have a concern about potential financial crime, fraud, or a compliance issue involving fortuni or another user, please contact our compliance team at compliance@promrkts.com. All reports are treated confidentially. You will not suffer any detriment for reporting a concern in good faith. Employees and partners can also raise concerns through our internal whistleblower channel.
